description: Pixel designs, up to 32×32 in 16 colours, for a canvas on the playa (playa build "canvas with design <name> on lot <n>"), flags, signs and easels. save: give name, palette (one letter to a "#rrggbb" colour) and rows (strings of those letters, "." for clear), or script, a Lisp form like (draw 16 16 {:r "#e25d6a" :w "#fffaf0"} (fn [x y] (if (even? x) :r :w)) {:name "stripes"}). Saving under a name you have replaces it. list: your designs. forget: clears one by name. Chapter: plazmi://skill/lisp (/skill/lisp on the site).

key.description: Your Plazmi key, pz_…; only needed when this chat doesn't remember you.

name.description: save or forget: the design's name, up to 24 characters.

palette.description: save: one letter to a colour, like {"b": "#2f5e9e"}.

rows.description: save: one string per row, a palette letter per pixel, "." for clear.

script.description: save, instead of the grid: a Lisp form that ends with a design, (draw …) or (design …).

name: draw
